title: 第一卷 第1章 世上有两种人碰不得
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这世上有两种人碰不得：一种是瘾君子，一种是烂赌鬼。

王建军偏偏是第二种。

跃下高楼那一刻，往事一幕幕浮现，最令他痛心疾首的莫过于1989年的那一天。

那一天，输红眼的他为了逼妻子李南枝交出宝贝女儿的治病钱，动手将她暴打了一顿。

绝望的妻子看着眼前这个歇斯底里的男人，彻底心死，当晚就带着女儿偷偷坐车回娘家。

也正是那一天，妻子和女儿出了车祸，双双殒命。

至此之后，父亲终生不肯原谅他，母亲气得瘫痪，妹妹为了照顾母亲辍学，弟弟亦与他彻底决裂离家出走！

一家人因他一人而家破人亡。

此后的日子，王建军终日以酒度日，浑浑噩噩，直到他踏上了天台。

那一天是什么时候来着？

王建军使劲想，但却无论如何想不起来。

终于，生命即将终结的那一刹那，他突然想起来了。

那一天是1989年6月14日！

“王建军，你个畜生，那是你女儿的救命钱！”

女人歇斯底里的尖叫，将王建军吓了一个激灵，浑身寒毛直立。

他这是死了？

要不然，怎么还能见到自己的妻子。

没错，眼前这个脸色苍白、眼窝因营养不良而凹陷下去的女人，正是他的妻子李南枝。

但即便如此，依旧难掩她绝色的容颜、独有的气质，还有那股淡淡的梅花清香。

错不了，眼前的女人就是他的妻子李南枝！

可是妻子和女儿，应该在三十几年前就死了啊？

“王建军，你个畜生，你怎么不说话了！”

女人用力抢回王建军手上的钱。

王建军此时整个人还处于呆愣状态，任由妻子抢走钱。

我这是穿越了？

王建军猛地抓住李南枝瘦小的手腕，这真实的触感，绝对不是错觉！

还有这间四处漏风的土房，不正是他和妻子相依为命的老房子吗？

但即便如此，王建军依旧不敢相信，直到他看到那个紧紧抱住妈妈小腿、一脸倔强怒瞪着他的小丫头。

那是他的女儿啊！

他终于相信，自己确实穿越了，回到了1989年6月14日！

Page (1/3)

There are two kinds of people in this world that are untouchable: drug addicts and bad gamblers.

Wang Jianjun happens to be the second type.

The moment he jumped off the tall building, scenes from the past emerged, and the one that made him most heartbroken was that day in 1989.

That day, in order to force his wife Li Nanzhi to hand over the money for her baby daughter's medical treatment, he beat her up.

The desperate wife looked at the hysterical man in front of her and was completely heartbroken. She took her daughter and secretly took a car back to her parents' home that night.

It was also that day that his wife and daughter were in a car accident and both died.

After that, his father refused to forgive him for the rest of his life, his mother was paralyzed with anger, his sister dropped out of school to take care of her mother, and his brother completely broke up with him and ran away from home!

A whole family was destroyed because of him alone.

In the days that followed, Wang Jianjun drank all day long, feeling muddleheaded until he stepped onto the rooftop.

When does that day come?

Wang Jianjun thought hard, but couldn't remember it.

Finally, at the moment when his life was about to end, he suddenly remembered.

That day was June 14, 1989!

"Wang Jianjun, you beast, that is your daughter's life-saving money!"

The woman's hysterical screams frightened Wang Jianjun, making the hair on his body stand on end.

Is he dead?

Otherwise, how could he still see his wife?

Yes, the pale woman in front of him with sunken eye sockets due to malnutrition is his wife Li Nanzhi.

But even so, it is still difficult to hide her stunning appearance, unique temperament, and the faint fragrance of plum blossoms.

There is no mistake, the woman in front of him is his wife Li Nanzhi!

But my wife and daughter should have died more than thirty years ago?

"Wang Jianjun, you beast, why don't you speak?"

The woman tried her best to snatch the money back from Wang Jianjun.

Wang Jianjun was still in a daze at this time and allowed his wife to snatch the money.

Have I traveled through time?

Wang Jianjun suddenly grabbed Li Nanzhi's thin wrist. This real touch was definitely not an illusion!

And this mud house with air leakage everywhere, isn't it the old house where he and his wife depended on each other?

But even so, Wang Jianjun still couldn't believe it until he saw the little girl hugging her mother's calf tightly and glaring at him with a stubborn look on her face.

That's his daughter!

He finally believed that he had indeed traveled through time and returned to June 14, 1989!
